issues.detail: The Greek 'ιδια γενεα' (his own generation/lineage) refers to the people of his own time/generation. The Vietnamese 'dòng dõi mình' implies his own descendants or lineage, which changes the scope of who he served.

The Greek 'ειδεν διαφθοραν' (he saw corruption) is a specific theological/eschatological point. While 'đã thấy sự hư nát' is present, the Vietnamese structure makes it slightly ambiguous whether he saw it *after* being added to the fathers or as a distinct observation of the world/generation.
